title: AFib after the hypnosis session
summary: Mario Woods tells of AFib after the hypnosis session, about date not stated at Georgia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: hypnosis when uh Robert Upson finished that hypnosis something was wrong with me

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear weapons site who says he was abducted by a UFO, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a hypnosis session in Georgia meant to bring back his memories of the event. He says that when the hypnotist, Robert Upson (also named as Bob Upton), finished, something was wrong with him, and he developed AFib, an irregular heartbeat. He tells it as a sign that the memories, or the experience itself, took a real physical toll.
